components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard input; desktop type becomes compact at 768 px.
components.css: .ds-input{height:2rem;min-width:0;padding:0.25rem 0.625rem;border:1px solid var(--input, #d8cbc8);border-radius:1rem;background:transparent;color:var(--foreground, #251820);font:400 1rem/1.5rem "Geist Variable", sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;outline:none;transition:border-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms;} .ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, #70616a);} .ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring, #7962cd);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #7962cd) 50%, transparent);} .ds-input:disabled{opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none;background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--input, #d8cbc8) 50%, transparent);} .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--destructive, #d84557);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive, #d84557) 20%, transparent);} :host-context(.dark) .ds-input{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--input, #5b4657) 30%,transparent);} @media(min-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:0.875rem;line-height:1.25rem;}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition-duration:0.01ms;}} :host-context(.dark) .ds-input:disabled{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--input, #5b4657) 80%,transparent);} :host-context(.dark) .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--destructive, #ff7a88) 50%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--destructive, #ff7a88) 40%,transparent);}

components.css: .ds-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.25rem;border-radius:9999px;padding:0.125rem 0.5rem;background:var(--color-status-success-surface, oklch(97.9% 0.021 166.113));color:var(--color-status-success-text, oklch(50.8% 0.118 165.612));font:700 0.6875rem/1.5 "Geist Variable", sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-status-dot{width:0.375rem;height:0.375rem;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;} :host-context(.dark) .ds-status{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-status-success-dark-surface, oklch(76.5% 0.177 163.223)) 10%,transparent);color:var(--color-status-success-dark-text, oklch(84.5% 0.143 164.978));}

narrative.overview:
Creamy paper surrounds
plum cosmos, a cup holds a small universe, and geometric orbits suggest the wait
before a bright reaction on stream. The mood is warm, playful, and quietly
magical. Bitter gives the identity an editorial voice; Geist keeps live work clear.

Brand scenes carry the strongest atmosphere. Lists, forms, and working panels
remain calm and compact. Repeated signatures are the arched landing illustration,
coffee cup, orbital paths, and roasted-gold navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream and espresso surfaces with violet actions and gold navigation.
Expressive Bitter headings paired with compact Geist controls.
Atmospheric entry scenes and restrained working panels.
dos: **Do** concentrate the coffee-cosmic atmosphere in entry scenes and headers.
**Do** keep purple actions, gold navigation, and status colors distinguishable.
**Do** reuse the cup, orbit, and bean motifs with clear space around text.

**Do** check translated wrapping, keyboard focus, mobile overflow, and both themes
  when extending the implementation.
donts: **Don't** replace working panels with heavily illustrated containers.
**Don't** substitute decorative stars, emoji, or the logo for interface icons.
**Don't** treat source-level theme support as evidence of visual validation.
